  • Recent findings suggest that wondering how to tell the difference?
  • Feeling a bit puzzled about your feelings for boo?
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Love can feel like navigating a choose-your-own-adventure book with half the pages missing. Are you truly in love or just caught in a wave of infatuation? Sometimes, what seems like a heart-thumping romance may be a fleeting crush.

Recent findings suggest that wondering how to tell the difference? We’ve got you! Here’s a rundown of the 10 signs you’re not really in love.

Feeling a bit puzzled about your feelings for boo? That’s pretty normal. But before you start planning your future or picking out matching Halloween costumes, you may wanna make sure it’s real love and not a case of a serious crush.

Here are some signs that you may not really be in love:.

Industry observers note that caught up in the romance novel vibe? If you’re all about the feelings of being in love rather than who’s sharing your popcorn, it might just be that you’re smitten with the idea of love itself.

Time to check if your relationship is more about the fairy tale than the real person.

According to recent reports, chatting with your partner shouldn’t feel as shallow as a kiddie pool. If deep talks are tougher than pulling teeth and rarer than a unicorn, it’s a red flag.

Sticking to small talk about the weather and dinner plans suggests the emotional depth for a lasting bond might be missing.

When discussions about future prepares feel as far-fetched as sci-fi adventures, they may reveal underlying doubts about the relationship’s viability.

Industry observers note that if imagining a future together feels unrealistic or undesirable, it’s time to ask yourself why. Real love prepares a future; infatuation lives for the weekend.

Remember when their sock on the floor was cute? If little quirks now make you more cranky than charmed, it might mean the love goggles are off, your feelings have shifted from affection to annoyance, and the reality check has bounced.

Love is seeing imperfections and adoring them anyway.

It has been revealed that feeling more at ease or more ‘yourself’ when your partner isn’t around is a telling sign. If you’re secretly throwing mini-parties when they leave the room, you need to stop and think. Real-deal love means missing their chaos when they’re gone, not celebrating the silence.

Shared values are the anchor of deep, lasting relationships. If your core values clash more than a polka dot and stripes ensemble, you’re in for a rough ride, as finding common ground could be challenging!

Lasting love grows from shared beliefs and mutual respect, not from opposing battle lines.

No respect? No future. Respect is as critical to love as air is to breathing. Without mutual respect, you might just be coexisting rather than genuinely connecting.

If you no longer admire or respect each other’s opinions and choices, sustaining a healthy relationship will be difficult.

Recent findings suggest that if they’re out of sight and totally out of mind, that’s not just independence — it might be indifference. When love is real, you should long for their laugh or lame jokes when they’re away. Could it be that your emotional attachment isn’t as strong as it should be for a lasting relationship?

Recent findings suggest that if your best moments are consistently away from your partner, your heart might not be in it to win it. Perhaps your relationship isn’t providing enough support or happiness.

True love enriches your life and doesn’t play second fiddle to your social circle. It’s time to evaluate where your emotional energy is invested.

Still window shopping while you’re supposedly locked down? It’s a sign you might not be all in. A love that lasts doesn’t keep a backup catalog — it’s too busy loving what it already has.

Knowing why you’re still scanning for alternatives can help you address what might be missing or unfulfilled in your relationship.

According to recent reports, are you genuinely in love or just in love with being in love? If you’re secretly thrilled when they’re not around, stuck in surface-level chit-chat, or dreading deep-future talks, these are cosmic signs that it’s rethink o’clock.

Don’t ignore the signals — tuning in now can save you heartache later and lead you toward a love that genuinely fulfills you.

SHoP Architects designs Novak Djokovic-backed Miami supertall skyscraper

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Newly introduced York studio SHoP Architects has released designs for a ribbed supertall skyscraper in Miami, announced alongside the launch of a luxury brand for which Serbian tennis player Novak Djokovic is developing amenity facilities.
  • SHoP Architects, who are behind some of New York City’s tallest buildings, designed the 1,049-foot-tall (320-metre-tall) skyscraper around ATMA, a luxury brand being rolled out by hospitality operator Aman Group.
  • If completed at the stated height, it would be taller than the city’s current tallest skyscraper, and have the same projected height as the in-progress Waldorf Astoria Hotel & Residences Miami, which has been cited as the city’s future tallest.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Images courtesy of Aman Group.

Newly introduced York studio SHoP Architects has released designs for a ribbed supertall skyscraper in Miami, announced alongside the launch of a luxury brand for which Serbian tennis player Novak Djokovic is developing amenity facilities.

SHoP Architects, who are behind some of New York City’s tallest buildings, designed the 1,049-foot-tall (320-metre-tall) skyscraper around ATMA, a luxury brand being rolled out by hospitality operator Aman Group.

If completed at the stated height, it would be taller than the city’s current tallest skyscraper, and have the same projected height as the in-progress Waldorf Astoria Hotel & Residences Miami, which has been cited as the city’s future tallest.

The skyscraper will include a hotel, residences and a members’ club. According to Aman Group, ATMA’s “advanced wellness programming and world-class sport facilities” will be developed “exclusively” with Djokovic, who is credited as a global partner of the new brand.

Designs for the skyscraper itself show a ribbed form of balconied terraces organised around a central void that runs from the crown to the podium.

It is planned for Miami’s Brickell neighbourhood, and Aman Group mentioned that the floor-to-ceiling windows of the skyscraper will merge the “futuristic architecture with the bay”.

Toronto-based interiors outfit Studio Paolo Ferrari has been chosen as the interiors lead on the project. It will include condos with one to five bedrooms, with six-bedroom penthouses pushed to the top of the skyscraper.

The structure will have setbacks at the upper floors, presumably to create more panoramic views for residences in the penthouses.

The ATMA concept is based around what Aman Group calls “performance-driven lifestyle”.

“Monolithic architecture meets biomorphic design, furniture is shaped naturally to the human form and ambience adjusts sensitively to residents’ and guests’ circadian rhythm,” stated Aman Group.

Djokovic’s programme, meanwhile, will include a 120,000-square-foot spa and wellness centre.

“ATMA Miami will sit at the pinnacle of what performance living can achieve,” mentioned Djokovic.

OKO Group and Oak Row Equities were confirmed as developers for the project.

SHoP Architects is no stranger to supertall luxury residences. It designed Upcoming York’s skinniest supertall skyscraper to have single-floor apartments on the city’s so-called Billionaires Row. It also designed the Brooklyn Tower, the tallest structure in the borough.

Images courtesy of Aman Group.

Say What? 7 Tips to Unclog Your Blocked Ears

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 6 min read (1281 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Greatist

⏱️ ~6 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Earwax buildup, allergies, infections, or changes in air pressure might be behind your clogged ears.
  • It has been revealed that whether it’s from a cold, allergies, or changes in air pressure, blocked ears can disrupt your day-to-day activities and even cause discomfort.
  • Clogging can happen either on the inside or the outside of your eardrum.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Earwax buildup, allergies, infections, or changes in air pressure might be behind your clogged ears. There are many easy ways to get relief at home. Whether it’s from a cold, allergies, or changes in air pressure, blocked ears can disrupt your day-to-day activities and even cause discomfort. Thankfully, there are several effective methods to help unclog your ears and restore your hearing. Listen up! Why are my ears clogged? Clogging can happen either on the inside or the outside of your eardrum. Here are the most common ways your ears can get blocked: Earwax in the outer ear helps prevent particles and excess water from entering the middle ear. However, if earwax builds up too much outside the eardrum, it can cause a blockage. If you’ve been swimming recently, some water might be stuck in your ear canal, pushing against your eardrum. When that water hangs around too long, it can lead to a swimmer’s ear, an outer ear infection. Sinus infections, ear infections, and Eustachian tube dysfunction can pressure your eardrum’s inner side. Allergies can cause uncomfortable inflammation and congestion in your ears. Your sinuses, throat, and ears are connected, so when you feel stuffed up and sniffly, your inner ear feels the pain too. Changes in air pressure, like when you fly, can cause uncomfortable ear pressure. Best clogged ear remedies 1. Pop and unclog The easiest way to unclog your ears is by “popping” them. Just pinch your nose shut, seal your lips, and gently blow. This simple technique, known as the Valsalva maneuver, won’t clear earwax or fluid but is a common trick people use on planes. 2. Swallow, yawn, or chew The Eustachian tubes connect your middle ear to the back of your throat. They briefly open when you swallow, yawn, or chew. Altitude changes can cause these tubes to close, but chewing gum or yawning can help reopen them. Alternatively, you can try the Toynbee maneuver, where you hold your nose and swallow. 3. Ear drops Over-the-counter (OTC) ear drops can soften and dissolve excess earwax. If you prefer a DIY approach, warm a small amount of mineral oil and use an eye dropper to apply a few drops into your ear for a few minutes. Pro tip: Baby oil or olive oil can also be used, but make sure it’s not too hot. Additionally, diluted hydrogen peroxide drops can be helpful. 4. Warmth and gravity To loosen up clogged earwax, use a warm, damp washcloth as a compress. Lie down with the clogged ear facing down against the heated washcloth. Gravity and heat will help the earwax move along more easily. 5. Hit the steam room Steam can help drain sinuses and alleviate pressure in your inner ear. Close the bathroom door, let the hot shower run for a while, and then luxuriate with deep, cleansing breaths. 6. Take allergy medication Because your throat, sinuses, and ears are interconnected, any sickness affecting your sinuses or throat can also impact your ears. Over-the-counter antihistamines, decongestants, or nasal sprays can relieve sniffles, coughs, and ear discomfort. 7. Rinse away the gunk Rinsing your nasal passages with a medication-free saline solution can help reduce congestion and clear out mucus that might be causing ear blockage. You can also consider investing in a nasal irrigation system for more thorough mucus clearing. When to see your doctor Have you been unable to unclog your ears for a few days, or are you experiencing severe pain, fever, dizziness, hearing loss, fluid discharge, or unusual odor? If so, it’s crucial to contact your healthcare provider promptly. These symptoms may indicate an infection that needs medical attention. What not to do when you have clogged ears Cotton swabs: Q-tips and other cotton swabs to remove earwax can push it further into your ear canal, so don’t do it. Candling: Ear candles might seem like a fun party trick, but there’s no science to prove they work, and they’ve been shown to cause injuries. Sprays: Decongestant nasal sprays can be helpful, but using them too long can lead to rebound congestion. Drying solutions: A few drops of rubbing alcohol or a mixture of one part vinegar and one part alcohol can help dry out the ears when you have a swimmer’s ear. However, doing this regularly can lead to irritation. Takeaway Clogged ears are often caused by earwax buildup, allergies, infections, or changes in air pressure. You can use over-the-counter or DIY ear drops, irrigation kits, or warm compresses to unblock your ears. Antihistamines or nasal sprays can also help relieve clogs caused by allergies. PSA: Consult a healthcare provider if your blocked ears are painful or at-home remedies don’t work.

Industry News: Sid Lee Architecture references "rhythm of the vine" for curved Ontario hotel

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (538 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Dezeen

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Photography by James Brittain (unless stated otherwise).
  • Canadian studio Sid Lee Architecture has created a curved-glass hotel that takes cues from the burgeoning wine region of Ontario.
  • The Montreal-based studio recently unveiled The Clayfield Hotel, a 60-room hotel with a restaurant, ballroom and rooftop terrace in Niagara-on-the-Lake.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Photography by James Brittain (unless stated otherwise).

Canadian studio Sid Lee Architecture has created a curved-glass hotel that takes cues from the burgeoning wine region of Ontario.

The Montreal-based studio recently unveiled The Clayfield Hotel, a 60-room hotel with a restaurant, ballroom and rooftop terrace in Niagara-on-the-Lake.

The rounded 94,000-square-foot (8,732-square metre) hotel sits on a property in the historic village that is being transformed by winemakers.

“The Clayfield was conceived as a fresh hub for Niagara-on-the-Lake, a place where wine culture and hospitality find a home,” Martin Leblanc, architect and co-founding partner of Sid Lee Architecture, told Dezeen.

“Its layered contours, rounded geometry and rhythmic wood elements translate the surrounding vineyard landscape into a building that celebrates the region’s contribution to Canadian winemaking.”.

The hotel was conceived as a pavilion set in the emerging townscape between vineyards and the Clayfield Commons housing development on an agricultural road.

The curved form allows access and connection to its surroundings in multiple directions.

“The hotel acts as a threshold between these typologies, connecting the vineyard and the denser village-like development around it,” Leblanc stated.

“Its exterior wood elements recall the rhythm of the vine rows, the layered concrete refers to the clay soil and the reflective glass registers the changing light, sky and seasons.”.

The studio mentioned that the organic, natural flow of a hotel is essential to the lasting success of the design.

Working back and forth between the architecture and the interior design, the studio laid out spaces to progress from public to private and back again, integrating moments for visitors to discover the landscape.

Recent findings suggest that “As visitors approach and circulate around the building, it frames changing views of the vines, the plaza and the emerging neighbourhood,” Leblanc said. “The lobby acts as a gateway to the vineyard, while the rooftop terrace reconnects the hotel experience with its broader surroundings.”.

Meanwhile, the staircase acts as a connector, transition and centrepiece between the plaza, lobby and upper levels.

“Inside, we chose a palette that speaks to the natural beauty of Niagara’s wine country: walnut panelling, concrete, dark amaranth-coloured leather, greige limestone and woven fabrics,” Leblanc mentioned, calling out the limestone registration desk chiselled from the Niagara Escarpment and the restaurant’s curved bar that resembles the shape of the building.

With mostly Teknion furniture, each space represents a season of the vineyard, from spring in the lobby to winter in the guest rooms with more quiet, reserved furnishings that complete the rooms that fan out from the rounded concrete strata.

Sources indicate that founded in 2009, Sid Lee Architecture has six offices across North America and Europe. The studio previously remodelled its own offices in an I.M. Pei office building, overhauled the interiors of the iconic Fairmont Queen Elizabeth Hotel and created an artisan-inspired workplace for video game designers – all in Montreal.

Are Tangerines Good for You? 5 Health Benefits You Might Love

📅 26 Jun 2024 | ⏱️ 4 min read (746 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Greatist

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that tangerines are not just tasty — they’re a powerhouse of nutrients.
  • It has been revealed that tangerines are nutritional powerhouses.
  • Industry observers note that tangerines are teeny cousins of the orange but with a thinner, easier-to-peel skin.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that tangerines are not just tasty — they’re a powerhouse of nutrients. Packed with tangy flavor and vibrant orange color, these citrus delights offer a host of health benefits. From boosting your immune system to rejuvenating your skin, tangerines are nutrient-rich allies for your well-being. Let’s delve into their nutritional profile and discover why they’re a smart addition to your diet.

It has been revealed that tangerines are nutritional powerhouses. Here’s what each of these little champs pack under their orange belts:.

Industry observers note that tangerines are teeny cousins of the orange but with a thinner, easier-to-peel skin. They boast a sweet and juicy flavor and pack a ton of vitamins, particularly vitamin C, as well as minerals like potassium, antioxidants, and dietary fiber.

These tiny bursts of sunshine have many benefits that can significantly enhance your health. Here’s why you might want to make tangerines a regular part of your diet:.

Tangerines are loaded with vitamin C, turning them into tiny, tasty guardians for your health. This crucial vitamin supercharges your immune system by enhancing the function and effectiveness of white blood cells, which are essential for fighting off pathogens and infections. By improving the activity and response of these cells, vitamin C helps your body combat a wide range of infections more effectively.

Therefore, regular consumption of these mini-oranges satisfies your taste buds and boosts your body’s defense mechanisms — a win-win!

Want that glow? Tangerines have got you covered. They’re high in potassium, a real game-changer for regulating hydration and balancing fluid levels in your skin cells. This essential mineral keeps your skin cells plump and hydrated, warding off pesky, dry, dull patches.

Plus, potassium supports the removal of toxins and wastes, which means clearer, more radiant skin.

Tangerines are also a fantastic source of vitamin A, which strengthens the outer layer of your skin, smoothing out wrinkles and reducing fine lines. Along with vitamin C, it’s a potent antioxidant, protecting your skin from the damaging and aging effects of free radicals.

Are you having tummy troubles? Tangerines can help with a fiber boost that keeps things moving smoothly along your digestive tract.

Recent findings suggest that these zesty little superheroes are your gut’s latest best friends. They’re loaded with fiber that bulks up and softens things down there, making your bathroom visits smooth and speedy. This fruity fix helps manage everything from irregular pit stops to those bloated bleurgh days.

In a recent development, fiber also balances your gut flora, promoting a healthy microbial environment in your intestines. This balance is crucial for optimal digestion, nutrient absorption, and immune function.

So, grab a tangerine to remedy your belly blues next time your gut feels out of whack.

Tangerines are a dynamo when it comes to battling serious health baddies like cancer and heart disease. These little orange wonders are loaded with flavonoids, natural compounds that help with heart health and cancer prevention.

According to recent reports, flavonoids help relax the blood vessels, lowering blood pressure levels and reducing the strain on your heart. This helps keep your ticker ticking smoothly and reduces the risk of cardiovascular diseases like heart attacks and strokes.

Sources indicate that but wait, there’s more! When it comes to cancer, flavonoids mess with the bad guys — cancer cells — stopping them from multiplying and spreading their nonsense around your body.

Keep your peepers sharp with a dose of vitamin A from tangerines. This essential nutrient and compounds like beta-carotene shield your eyes from age-related issues and support healthy vision. It plays a key role in creating rhodopsin, a protein in your eyes that allows you to see in low-light conditions.

Munching on tangerines helps keep your night vision in superhero shape and supports overall eye function, keeping your peepers sharp and responsive.

Furthermore, tangerines contain other essential eye health nutrients, like lutein and zeaxanthin. These antioxidants are found in high concentrations in the retina, where they help filter blue light and prevent oxidative damage, further protecting the eyes from conditions like cataracts.

Sure, tangerines are delish and make your taste buds do a happy dance, but they’re also packed with nutrients that can seriously amp up your well-being.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Cosentino aims to put the creative freedom of architects and designers front and centre with its Ēclos surface, designed for three-dimensional compositions with refined edges, corners and waterfall ends.
  • Ēclos is the Spanish brand’s latest mineral surface material, made with advanced methods to emulate the look of natural stone and be free of crystalline silica.
  • The surface is made with Cosentino’s proprietary Inlayr manufacturing process, which makes the rich and naturalistic veining run through the slab.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Cosentino aims to put the creative freedom of architects and designers front and centre with its Ēclos surface, designed for three-dimensional compositions with refined edges, corners and waterfall ends.

Ēclos is the Spanish brand’s latest mineral surface material, made with advanced methods to emulate the look of natural stone and be free of crystalline silica.

The surface is made with Cosentino’s proprietary Inlayr manufacturing process, which makes the rich and naturalistic veining run through the slab.

This gives Ēclos a premium look, Cosentino explained, and makes it a fitting constituent for the most sophisticated interiors.

According to Cosentino, it is in the junctions and details that a kitchen or room feels resolved and where its architectural character emerges.

“For architects and designers, the section deserves as much consideration as the elevation,” mentioned the tech giant. “The placement of a joint, the treatment of an edge and the relationship between adjoining surfaces shape how a material is perceived.”.

“These details establish the architectural language of an element, whether the intention is to suggest a continuous volume or to make its assembly visible.”.

Although surfaces are often selected based on their colour or pattern, Cosentino says that full-body design should be just as crucial a consideration, allowing exposed edges and transitions between levels or materials to contribute to building a coherent form.

“With Ēclos, the patterning is constructed within the slab rather than confined to its face,” continued the brand. “That makes the relationship between surface and depth an important part of the design conversation, particularly where edges remain visible.”.

“The interest lies not just in the appearance of the material, but in how it can be cut, assembled and brought into a project with adjacent finishes.”.

Its fabricators can advise how cutting, profiling, jointing and installation can help a designer’s vision come together.

The process can involve reviewing samples, fabrication drawings and, where appropriate, physical mock-ups.

“The position of a seam or the treatment of an exposed edge can subtly alter the proportions and perceived weight of an element,” noted Cosentino.

“The aim is not necessarily to make every joint disappear, but to make each one deliberate.”.

“Whether the intention is a continuous volume or a clearly expressed assembly, the junction deserves as much consideration as the surface itself,” the brand continued.

Ēclos rolled out earlier this year and joins an expanding portfolio of low-silica, high-recycled mineral surface worktops from Cosentino, including Silestone, Dekton and Sensa.

It is suitable for both residential and commercial environments and can be used on worktops, splashbacks, walls and other surfaces.

The first Ēclos collection – Eclectic Veins – incorporates 10 stone-like designs, ranging from ice-white styles to dramatic darks, all made with a minimum of 50 per cent recycled content.

The material is practical for everyday use, withstanding scratches and stains, and is easy to clean and maintain.

It is also resistant to temperatures of up to 220 degrees Celsius, including contact with hot cookware.

To learn more about Cosentino and Ēclos, visit the company’s website.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Relationships aren’t just about candlelit dinners and cozy sofa nights — they’re complex AF, filled with ups, downs, twists, and turns.
  • Each relationship phase serves a unique purpose, helping you learn more about each other, yourself, and the kind of relationship you want to build.
  • Whether you’re in the throes of a new romance or navigating the challenges of a long-term commitment, continue reading to learn how to rock each phase like a pro.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Relationships aren’t just about candlelit dinners and cozy sofa nights — they’re complex AF, filled with ups, downs, twists, and turns. From the first flush of love to the settled comfort of commitment, relationships have stages that evolve with time.

Each relationship phase serves a unique purpose, helping you learn more about each other, yourself, and the kind of relationship you want to build. Understanding the dynamics of these stages is crucial for any couple (or throuple!) aiming to develop a lasting bond.

Whether you’re in the throes of a new romance or navigating the challenges of a long-term commitment, continue reading to learn how to rock each phase like a pro.

From those “can’t eat, can’t sleep” early days to the “let’s build an empire” moments, each relationship stage is like a season of your fave drama binge. But, like any good drama, the plot thickens as time passes and things change. Here’s what to expect, month by month:.

Recent findings suggest that welcome to the love bubble, where everything about your significant other seems nothing short of magical. The positives overshadow any negatives, creating a blissfully skewed balance sheet of love. It lasts from about 6 months to 2 years for most peeps, but many folks say they are still madly in love even after 20 years together!

Sources indicate that research shows that during this stage, the prefrontal cortex, which is crucial for critically judging others, shows decreased activity. In other words, you’re less likely to focus on your partner’s faults and more likely to overlook their flaws.

Sources indicate that lurve also activates specific areas in the brain that are driven by goals and rewards. These areas are rich in dopamine and oxytocin receptors, chemicals that make you feel good and bonded to others. They encourage you to pursue and maintain a relationship because it feels rewarding and fulfilling.

If the euphoric stage is the wild, pulse-racing party of love, the early attachment stage is the cozy after-party where things get real comfortable. In the thrilling initial phase, your brain is doped up on dopamine, but as this initial buzz begins to mellow, a more sophisticated part of the brain starts to step up — the ventral pallidum.

Now, after the first year or so, deeper bonds are formed, helped along by attachment hormones like vasopressin and oxytocin, also fondly known as “the love hormone.” These hormones help transform the electric excitement of new love into a warm, enduring attachment.

Recent findings suggest that hold tight because the crisis stage hits around 5 to 7 years, and it’s a true test of your relationship’s resilience. This phase often feels like a rollercoaster, where life’s challenges can either pull you apart or push you closer together. Many couples experience a drift during this time, and how you handle it — either by addressing the problems head-on or continuing to drift — can define your future together.

In a recent development, significant life events, like becoming parents, often occur during this stage and can intensify the pressure. These events can either strengthen your bond through shared responsibilities and mutual love or strain it to the breaking point. Successfully navigating this stage means moving beyond mere survival to fostering a deeper, more meaningful connection.

If you’ve made it this far, congrats, you’re in the deep attachment stage! Post-crisis, you’re looking at 7 years and beyond where you settle into that deep, comfy love. No more daily fireworks — now it’s about a slow-burning ember that warms the house.

You know each other inside and out, warts and all. It’s about unconditional support, knowing looks across crowded rooms, and being each other’s rock. Welcome to the good life!

Every relationship is a blend of sweet and sour and everything in between. Understanding the stages, from the initial euphoria to the deep attachment stage, helps you embrace the journey, keep your bond strong, and prepare your heart for whatever comes next. So buckle up and enjoy the ride — it’ll be worth it!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that vibration plates are like mini surfboards that give you a good shimmy while you’re exercising. Though you won’t find a mountain of extensive research behind them, you may be impressed by their possible benefits.

We asked a weightlifting coach to explain and show us how to add good vibrations to our workout routine.

These machines, which look like platforms or scales, are designed to activate something called whole-body vibration (WBV). WBV makes the body work harder by forcing it to contract muscles automatically.

Fans of WBV like to perform classic exercises on top of these machines, including:.

Research points to WBV’s ability to boost blood flow.

Weightlifting coach Jarrod Nobbe explains that vibration plates help move blood by stimulating muscle contractions through rapid vibrations.

“The rhythmic contraction and relaxation of muscles help pump blood more efficiently throughout the body,” he claims.

As Nobbe adds, movement generally increases blood flow and core temperature, preparing the body for activity. This means vibration plates may be an excellent warm-up activity.

A 2021 study demonstrated that WBV can be an alternative exercise for older adults, boosting the effects of strengthening exercise.

Nobbe indicates this is because WBV engages muscles in a way that mimics resistance training.

“The vibrations activate and force muscles to contract and relax multiple times per second, which can lead to gains in muscle strength and endurance over time, especially when combined with specific exercises,” he says.

Nobbe points to some anecdotal evidence suggesting that regular use of vibration plates may help boost energy levels, possibly thanks to increased blood circulation and enhanced muscle activation.

“Ultimately, I stand by the idea that movement is medicine,” Nobbe notes. “Tons of research already proves that regular physical activity boosts mood, mental health, and promotes energy levels.”.

It has been revealed that nobbe says WBV may reduce muscle soreness, stiffness, and inflammation by encouraging blood flow to the muscles. This, he explains, aids in faster recovery post-exercise or injury.

WBV has been shown to improve bone mineral density, which Nobbe points out may positively affect those at risk of osteoporosis.

“The mechanical vibrations stimulate bone cells, potentially leading to increased bone density and strength, delivering the same positive bone health benefits of resistance training,” he indicates.

“Unfortunately, vibration plates aren’t a one-stop shop for weight loss,” Nobbe notes.

He explains that vibration plates alone are unlikely to significantly reduce belly fat without dietary changes and additional exercise.

“While vibration plates can contribute to overall calorie expenditure and muscle activation, targeted fat loss requires a comprehensive approach including diet, cardio exercise, and resistance training,” he says.

These tips will help you stand on your vibration plate with a slight bend at your knee or perform exercises on top of it.

More research is needed around WBV — AKA what happens when you use a vibration plate — but existing smaller research is promising.

Use your machine carefully, and remember to maintain a healthy lifestyle and workout routine.

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Framery explained that the EU and US discard 11 million tonnes of furniture a year.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to office pod brand Framery, when companies resize or move, desks and meeting-room furniture often aren’t deemed “worth the cost of moving” and are discarded during the process.

Framery explained that the EU and US discard 11 million tonnes of furniture a year.

Specifically, the brand points to a study for the European Environmental Bureau, which found that in the EU, 80 to 90 per cent of office furniture is burned or landfilled.

According to the Environmental Protection Agency, in the US, less than one per cent is recycled.

Framery aims to tackle this glitch with its office pod subscription service, presenting a more environmentally-friendly alternative to disposing of office furniture when a lease runs out, for example.

According to recent reports, “The ‘fast furniture’ trend means 80 per cent of furniture ends up in landfills,” remarked Framery’s chief design officer, Joonas Vartola. “We wanted to create a pod that’s part of the solution, not the problem.”.

“Framery pods are built for heavy use, keeping them in the field for tens of thousands of sessions and out of landfills,” Vartola added.

For example, if there’s an increase in staff and more pods are needed, or if an office’s layout changes.

The scheme covers the full range of its signature line pods, from one-person phone booths to meeting pods.

According to Saija Serpola, managing director and founding partner at IR Partners, using the pods has enabled increased flexibility and reduced financial risk when investing in additional office furniture.

“We can terminate, increase, or change the solution as our organisation develops.”.

Framery pods are built from mono-materials, including steel, aluminium, glass and PET.

“Our pods with heavy-duty, high-quality materials engineered to withstand wear and tear,” said Vartola. “It’s all about reducing waste, from design to decades of use.”.

As part of the scheme, when a change is required, the pods are dismantled, shipped and rebuilt, rather than discarded into landfill.

According to recent reports, according to Framery, each pod is designed for disassembly, with all parts replaceable and recyclable. This includes everything from interior panels, glass, upholstery, carpet, ventilation units and seals.

During refurbishment, each pod is restored to as-upcoming condition and delivered to its next office with a lifetime warranty.

“That is a manufacturing question before it is a commercial one, and it is settled years earlier, on the drawing board.”.

To learn more, visit Framery’s website.

It has been revealed that protein farts are a common, albeit smelly, side effect of high-protein diets. They happen because of how proteins are digested. But(t) don’t worry! We have some tips to help you say goodbye to those pungent protein toots without giving up your gains.

According to recent reports, protein farts are episodes of flatulence that don’t smell too pleasant! They’re generally due to upping your protein intake from supplements like protein shakes.

And while these butt whistles may be embarrassing, you’ll be glad to know they’re generally harmless.

Farts consist of different gases. The most stinky odors usually come from your gut bacteria, producing sulfur-containing compounds as they break down food. The main culprit is hydrogen sulfide, which gives off a characteristic rotten egg smell, yum!

But why do your protein choices lead to thunder from down under?

Well, there’s not much evidence that a high-protein diet causes protein farts. However, there’s some anecdotal evidence that supplementary protein — like protein bars, protein shakes, and powder powders — increases flatulence, but it’s likely due to non-protein ingredients like lactose.

Supplements containing whey protein or casein are derived from milk and are high in lactose, which can increase flatulence. If your body can’t properly digest lactose, it ends up in your colon, where bacteria feast on it, producing — you guessed it — more gas and cheek flapping.

According to recent reports, so, whey protein can throw a curveball for those who are lactose intolerant or sensitive. Surprisingly, it might also stir up digestive drama even for folks who typically handle dairy like champs, potentially due to additives like fart-inducing sweeteners or thickeners.

In a recent development, some people may also have more significant concerns digesting protein. Proteins are major, complex molecules — breaking them down is no small task for your gut. Plant-based protein supplements, like those based on soya beans, may also worsen flatulence.

FYI: Another reason why flatulence is common with protein powders and supplements is due to the addition of artificial sweeteners in the powders and bars, like sugar alcohols, sucralose, sorbitol, xylitol, and stevia.

If you’re looking to continue your protein regimen without becoming a walking, talking whoopee cushion, here are some strategic adjustments you can make:.

In a recent development, don’t just dive into the deep end with your protein intake — wade in slowly. Gradually increasing the amount of protein you consume allows your digestive system to adjust without getting overwhelmed. This step-by-step approach can help minimize the likelihood of excessive gas.

According to recent reports, keep the water flowing. Drinking plenty of water is crucial as it helps your digestive system handle higher protein levels more efficiently. Proper hydration aids in the breakdown and absorption of nutrients, which can help prevent gas buildup.

In a recent development, sometimes, your body needs a little extra help. Enzyme supplements like Beano or Lactaid can be game-changers, especially if you consume proteins that your body struggles with. These supplements help break down proteins and lactose, making digestion smoother and less gassy.

It has been revealed that variety isn’t just the spice of life — it can also be the solution to your protein fart problems. If whey protein tends to upset your stomach, explore other options like plant-based or animal-based proteins that might be easier to digest. Diversifying your protein sources can also ensure you get a broad range of nutrients.

In a recent development, what you blend your protein powder with can make a substantial difference. If you’re whipping up a protein shake, be mindful of adding high-fiber fruits and vegetables, as these can also increase gas production. Try to find a balance that allows you to enjoy the benefits of protein and fiber without the extra flatulence.

Introducing probiotics into your diet can improve your gut health, which can help manage and reduce gas production. Whether through supplements or probiotic-rich foods like yogurt, kefir, or sauerkraut, boosting your gut flora can aid in better overall digestion and less discomfort from gas.

According to recent reports, protein farts are a rather windy side effect of a high-protein diet, but they don’t have to knock you off course. Try easing into your protein consumption, staying hydrated, diversifying your protein sources, and integrating enzyme supplements or probiotics to max those gains, minus the stink bombs!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

What's your FI number? Calculate it in 60 seconds.

The one number that changes everything.

What $10,000 grows to at different rates over 30 years — the rate difference matters more than you think.

$10,000 invested for 30 years at 6% annual return.

$10,000 invested for 30 years at 8% annual return.

$10,000 invested for 30 years at 10% annual return.

Free calculators, a personalized FI roadmap, and a community of 25K+ on the same journey.

According to recent reports, future value (FV) is the projected worth of an investment at a specific point in the future, based on an assumed rate of growth. It answers the most practical question in investing: "If I invest this money today, what will it be worth in 10, 20, or 30 years?".

According to recent reports, future value calculations rest on compound interest — the principle that your returns earn their own returns over time. Albert Einstein reportedly called compound interest "the eighth wonder of the world," and while the attribution is debatable, the math is not. The difference between simple interest (returns on your original investment only) and compound interest (returns on your investment plus accumulated returns) becomes enormous over long time horizons.

The basic future value formula for a lump sum investment is:.

For example, $10,000 invested at 8% for 20 years:.

FV = $10,000 x (1.08)^20 = $10,000 x 4.661 = $46,610.

The table reveals two critical insights. First, small differences in return rates produce massive differences over long periods — $10,000 at 6% grows to $57,435 over 30 years, while the same amount at 10% grows to $174,494. That 4-percentage-point difference triples the outcome. Second, time is the dominant variable. At 8%, your money doubles roughly every 9 years — so 30 years gives you more than three doublings, turning $10,000 into over $100,000.

Most people do not invest a single lump sum and walk away. They invest regularly — monthly or per paycheck — over decades. The future value of a series of regular contributions uses a different formula called the future value of an annuity:.

FV = PMT x [((1 + r)^n - 1) / r].

Where PMT is the periodic contribution, r is the periodic rate, and n is the total number of periods.

In practice, you do not need to calculate this by hand. The insight that matters is this: regular contributions are far more powerful than most people realize because each contribution starts its own compounding clock. Your first $500 contribution compounds for the full 30 years, while your 360th contribution (at month 360) compounds for just one month — but together they build wealth that dwarfs a single lump sum.

A person investing $500 per month at 8% for 30 years accumulates $745,180 — from total contributions of only $180,000. That means $565,180, or 76% of the final balance, came from compound returns rather than your own deposits. This is the engine of wealth building.

Sources indicate that every future value calculation should be done twice — once in nominal terms and once in real (inflation-adjusted) terms. The nominal return is the raw number your investments earn. The real return subtracts inflation, showing you what your money will actually buy.

Sources indicate that historically, the S&P 500 has returned roughly 10% nominally and 7% after inflation. The difference matters enormously over long periods:.

That $1.13 million in nominal terms has the purchasing power of roughly $610,000 in today's dollars — still excellent, but nearly half less than the headline number suggests. When planning for FI, always use real returns (6-7%) rather than nominal returns (9-10%) to avoid overestimating what your portfolio will actually support in retirement spending.

The Rule of 72 is the simplest and most useful mental math tool in investing. Divide 72 by your annual rate of return to estimate how many years it takes for your investment to double:.

According to recent reports, this works in reverse too. If you want to know what rate of return you need to double your money in 15 years: 72 / 15 = 4.8%. The Rule of 72 is an approximation — it is most accurate for rates between 5% and 12% — but it is remarkably precise within that range and far faster than pulling out a calculator.

The FI community uses future value calculations as the backbone of retirement planning. The process works in three steps:.

In a recent development, the table highlights how starting balance and monthly contribution interact. Notice that increasing your monthly contribution from $1,500 to $2,500 (a $1,000 increase) with a $100,000 starting balance cuts 3.5 years off your time to $1 million. This is the savings rate lever in action — the amount you save each month matters more than any other variable you control.

Industry observers note that A common question is whether it is better to invest a lump sum now or spread contributions over time (dollar-cost averaging). The math is clear: lump sum investing wins approximately two-thirds of the time because markets trend upward over the long term. However, dollar-cost averaging reduces the psychological risk of investing a large amount right before a downturn and provides a behavioral advantage that keeps many investors on track. For most FI-seekers, the question is academic — you invest each paycheck as it arrives because you do not have a large lump sum sitting on the sidelines.

Free calculators, a personalized FI roadmap, and a community of 25K+ on the same journey.

When projecting your portfolio growth for retirement planning, use real (inflation-adjusted) returns of 6-7% rather than nominal returns of 9-10%. A $1 million nominal balance in 30 years has the purchasing power of roughly $550,000 in today's dollars at 2% average inflation. Planning with real returns ensures you are targeting a portfolio that can actually support your desired spending level.

Sources indicate that track your actual spending for 3 months and annualize it. Multiply by 25 to get your FI number using the 4% safe withdrawal rate. If you spend $60,000 per year, your FI number is $1,500,000.

Industry observers note that add up all retirement accounts (401k, IRA, Roth IRA, HSA), taxable brokerage accounts, and savings. Exclude home equity and non-liquid assets. This is your starting balance for the future value calculation.

It has been revealed that subtract your monthly spending from your monthly after-tax income. Include employer 401(k) match and any other automatic savings. This is your periodic contribution amount for the future value formula.

It has been revealed that use the future value of a lump sum plus annuity formula, or a simple online calculator, to project when your current balance plus monthly contributions will reach your FI number. Use 7% real return (after inflation) for conservative planning.

Test what happens if you increase contributions by $200/month, $500/month, or $1,000/month. Seeing the concrete impact of a savings rate increase — often shaving 2-5 years off your FI timeline — makes the trade-offs tangible and motivating.

For long-term stock market projections, use 7% for inflation-adjusted (real) returns or 10% for nominal returns based on the S&P 500 historical average. For a more conservative estimate, use 6% real. For bond-heavy portfolios, use 3-4% real. Always specify whether you are using nominal or real returns — mixing them up is one of the most common planning mistakes.

It has been revealed that future value calculations show what WOULD happen if returns were constant every year. In reality, markets fluctuate — you might earn 25% one year and lose 15% the next. Over 20-30 year periods, average returns tend to converge toward historical norms, making future value projections reasonably useful for planning. Treat them as directional estimates, not guarantees.

Future value asks: "What will $10,000 today be worth in 20 years?" Present value asks the reverse: "What is $50,000 in 20 years worth in today's dollars?" They use the same variables but in opposite directions. Present value is useful for evaluating whether a future payout (like a pension or annuity) is worth the cost today.

The Rule of 72 works for any compounding rate, including inflation. At 3% inflation, prices double every 24 years (72 / 3 = 24). This means $50,000 in annual spending today becomes $100,000 in 24 years in nominal terms — your purchasing power is halved if your income stays flat. This is why investing in assets that outpace inflation is essential.

For FI planning, future value is more intuitive — it tells you what your portfolio will grow to. However, the most practical approach is to calculate future value using real (after-inflation) returns. This effectively gives you a future value stated in today's purchasing power, which is what you actually need to know for spending planning.

Industry observers note that in tax-advantaged accounts (401k, IRA, Roth IRA, HSA), your investments compound without tax drag, so the standard future value formula works directly. In taxable accounts, capital gains taxes, dividend taxes, and tax-loss harvesting all affect your real return. A rough adjustment is to reduce your assumed return by 0.5-1.0% for taxable accounts to account for ongoing tax drag.

Future value calculations are the most practical tool in the FI planner's toolkit. They turn abstract concepts like compound growth and savings rate into concrete dollar amounts and specific timelines. The key takeaways are straightforward: use 7% real returns for conservative planning, always account for inflation by using real rather than nominal returns, and remember that your monthly contribution rate has a far larger impact on the outcome than chasing an extra point or two of return. The Rule of 72 gives you instant mental math for any investment decision — how long to double, what rate you need, and how inflation erodes purchasing power. Combined with a clear FI number and a disciplined savings rate, future value projections show you exactly when financial independence becomes reality. Run the numbers, test different scenarios, and let the math motivate you to increase that monthly contribution whenever you can.

Sources indicate that canva is one of those companies, and it's introduced a bunch of generative AI tools to its design platform. So the email I received yesterday made me do a double take. On the day that Anthropic completed the world's biggest IPO in history, it introduced an 'AI off switch'.

Canva has added two AI controls for both Free and Pro people. The generative AI switch can be used to hide all of its generative AI tools, including Magic Write, Magic Design, Magic Expand, Dream Lab and Canva Code. It can be switched on or off at any time.

Industry observers note that there's also an option to “See less AI content” on Canva's library of templates and design elements. This addresses complaints about the glut of AI-generated content making it harder to find quality work, something that's been causing problems on platforms as varied as Etsy and ArtStation.

In a recent development, canva indicates AI-generated content remains a "small portion" of its library and that such content is identified in its metadata. Turning on the new function isn't guaranteed to remove it completely, but it should put human-made templates and design elements first in search results and recommendations.

The addition of a couple of toggles to the UI wouldn't normally be breaking news, so the fact that Canva feels this deserved its own announcement is telling. After heavily promoting AI tools, it's now presenting the ability to turn them off as a groundbreaking advance – and it is. This might be the first time that a major AI-forward creative software developer has recognised that a sizable portion of its user base just isn't into it.

Sources indicate that an 'AI off button' is something that some creatives have been calling for. Part of the difficulty in implementing one is that it needs a definition of AI. Programs like Adobe's Photoshop have used machine learning for many years; it just wasn't branded as 'AI'. Many artists welcome tools that speed up their work, but not ones that do the creation part for them, especially if they're powered by models that were trained on unlicensed work.

In a recent development, canva's recognised that. The toggle only turns off generative AI tools, such as ones that generate fresh imagery, text or code from prompts. Assistive editing tools like Background Remover or Magic Grab, which lets you select and move an object in an image will still be available. Using them won't cause your work to be shamed with metadata identifying it as AI-generated.

Recent findings suggest that A 'no AI button' also requires a willingness from the provider. Since generative AI features are often charged on a per-use basis via credits, software companies generally want to encourage their customers to use them.

Adobe teased some impressive-looking AI-powered tools in the Adobe Max Sneaks presentation last week, but it's also clear that some customers detest generative AI, which has created a market for latest tools like the artist-led Niva app, which is promoting itself as AI-free art software.

Whether you’re battling irritation or want to give your “do” a upcoming lease on life, continue reading to learn how undercut hairstyles can be your ally in style and scalp health.

An undercut involves shaving or cutting hair very short on the sides or back of the head while leaving the hair on top longer.

Originally popular in men’s hairstyling, the undercut has crossed gender boundaries and gained popularity among peeps seeking a hairstyle that stands out.

It has been revealed that it’s a style that offers a stark contrast and is often used to add an edge to an otherwise conventional look. So whether it’s a side undercut, undercut pixie, mullet undercut, or nape undercut, these hairstyles for women, men, and folks of all genders enhance individuality while offering practical benefits like reduced drying time and less hair maintenance.

Choosing an undercut means embracing a hairstyle with a “heady” mix of aesthetic and practical benefits. Here’s why an undercut might be the refreshing change you need.

Industry observers note that ready to turn heads? The standout feature of an undercut is undoubtedly its unique appearance. Hidden under the longer layers, it packs a punch of boldness you can flaunt or conceal — whatever fits your vibe. You can control the reveal, whether you’re showcasing that edgy undercut for a night out or keeping it classy for the office.

Industry observers note that got a mane that’s more lioness than laid-back? An undercut might be your latest BFF. Strategically shaving or trimming the hair short on the sides or back dramatically dials down the volume. This means your thick, voluminous hair becomes way easier to manage and style, turning a heavy head of hair into something light and breezy.

Recent findings suggest that and the best part? You get to keep all the styling potential without any of the hassle. It’s a practical solution that doesn’t sacrifice style for comfort.

Are you chasing the clock every morning? An undercut could slash your prep time. With less hair to fuss over, you can breeze through your washing, drying, and styling routine faster than you can say “snooze button.”.

This trimmed-down approach is a time-saver and reduces the daily wear and tear from blow dryers and straighteners, keeping hair healthier in the long run.

It has been revealed that undercuts reduce your scalp’s weight and improve hair follicle airflow. This keeps the scalp cooler and reduces the buildup of sweat and oil that can lead to scalp irritation, dermatitis, and dandruff. As a result, undercuts could lead to more robust, healthier hair growth.

According to recent reports, ready to shake up your style with a cool undercut? Here’s a rundown of some options to add a dash of daring to your daily look:.

Are you looking for a dramatic change without total commitment? Try the side-swept undercut.

This style features a sleek shave on one side of the head, just above the ear, while keeping the hair on top and the other side longer.

It’s perfect for folks who love to play with contrast — sweep the top hair over to the shaved side for an instant bold statement.

It has been revealed that if subtlety is more your speed, this undercut is a wicked choice. It’s a shaved area tucked away at the back of the head or underneath the top layer of hair so that it can play a fantastic game of hide-and-seek.

According to recent reports, wear your hair down for a business-as-usual look, or tie it up to reveal a sneaky, stylish surprise. It’s an excellent choice for peeps wanting a touch of edge.

Are you feeling bold and artistic? Design Undercuts take personal expression to the next level. These chic undercuts are masterpieces, boasting intricate geometric patterns, sweet floral motifs, or any design that speaks to you.

It’s a softer version of the undercut that pairs beautifully with bob or lob cuts and offers a gentle nod to the undercut trend without going full-throttle.

It has been revealed that whether you’re drawn to the edgy designs or the subtle tapered style, an undercut could be a clever hack to simplify your morning routine. More time for coffee, less time with the comb!

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Sources indicate that NIVA is clean and light, works in your browser and it's led by a conceptual artist rather than a software developer.
  • Sources indicate that like the recent AI-coded Adobe clones, NIVA was born out of a frustration with the direction of a certain Californian software giant.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that adobe software might still rule in many industries, but there's a growing number of alternatives, from Canva's free Affinity to open-source Krita, Maxon's Autograph for motion design and DaVinci Resolve for video editing. Into the fray, comes a new artist-led app who's main selling points include the fact that it DOESN'T have any generative AI tools.

Sources indicate that NIVA is clean and light, works in your browser and it's led by a conceptual artist rather than a software developer. After it was announced on Instagram this week, it picked up close to 30,000 users in 48 hours.

Sources indicate that like the recent AI-coded Adobe clones, NIVA was born out of a frustration with the direction of a certain Californian software giant. But it takes a very different approach. It wasn't vibe coded, and it doesn't attempt to replicate the look, feel or functions of any one existing program.

The project's led by Stuart Semple, an artist who previously annoyed Anish Kapoor by creating a very black shade of black.

In a recent development, "With Adobe pushing AI further into its tools, I wanted somewhere people could still practise their craft and make things themselves. No AI doing it for them," he says. "NIVA is very much our own thing that we've all built together.

In a recent development, having previously made FREETONE, a free alternative to Pantone colours, with Culture Hustle, he started a Kickstarter for a project that was initially called Abode. He raised $240,000 from 3,000 backers, a few hundred of whom have been using the software regularly over a year and a half of beta testing. Around 10 people were involved more heavily in making the software, but Stuart says he largely built it himself "with help from some geeky friends from time to time when I've got stuck.".

At some point the name changed, and the project became NIVA. "I can't say I woke up to a nasty letter from the lawyers representing Adobe for legal reasons, so I won't," Stuart comments.

Sources indicate that NIVA has many of the core tools and functionalities of a program like Photoshop. There are brushes, a pen tool with boolean ops, cloning and healing tools, layers, curve adjustments and blend modes, type tools with kerning, layouts and gradients.

According to recent reports, but it's lighter, with a more minimalist UI and fewer menus despite providing the ability to draw vectors, manipulate photos and lay out text and pages all in a single app. Consumers also get a portfolio page, and there's a visual asset library called Storehouse, where you can store, sort, search and share work. Work can be exported in formats including PDF and SVG.

The pricing model is refreshing too. There's no subscription, and NIVA is free to use for an hour a day. You can buy full-day passes for $10 a time, or you can buy permanent access for $100. If you buy a day pass and later go permanent, the price of the day pass will be discounted. This allows a full opportunity to try the software before committing.

The response so far has been more enthusiastic than Stuart ever imagined. "I'm so excited and a bit freaked out", he admits, adding that what he finds most encouraging is that over half of the people who used NIVA in those first 48 hours made something with it within 40 seconds of getting access.

It has been revealed that "We're finally at a stage where it's stable enough and good enough to share with the world," he adds. It's only version one, the start of something I hope will be great. I still have loads I want to do with it".

You can use the software online at NIVA.design.

Joe is a regular freelance journalist and editor at Creative Bloq. A veteran news writer and photographer, he now works as a project manager at the London and Buenos Aires-based design, production and branding agency Hermana Creatives. There he manages a team of designers, photographers and video editors who specialise in producing visual content and design assets for the hospitality sector. He also dances Argentine tango.

Film and photography by Jim Stephenson.

The conversion of a Victorian hospital into facilities for the University of Edinburgh, shortlisted for the RIAS Andrew Doolan Best Building in Scotland Award, features in this video by photographer Jim Stephenson.

The film forms part of a series being published by Dezeen in collaboration with the Royal Incorporation of Architects in Scotland (RIAS) to highlight the annual award’s 2026 shortlist.

In the video, viewers are introduced to the Edinburgh Futures Institute by London-based Bennetts Associates, which involved the revitalisation of the Category A-listed building to create teaching spaces for the university, including a 450-seat auditorium.

Central to the building’s new function was the opening up of the programme to the public, highlighted by the creation of a public square at its front.

“A large part of the project was, of course, rescuing the building,” studio founder Rab Bennetts noted.

“Our mission, if you like, was to come back and reopen that main entrance, give it a sense of purpose again, open up the space to the street and make it a public space.”.

Established in 2002, the Andrew Doolan Best Building in Scotland Award is an annual award that highlights Scottish projects, with this year’s winner set to be revealed on 26 November.

Sources indicate that comprising three reuse projects, RIAS said this year’s shortlisted projects tap into “important conversations around community, collaboration, retrofit and reuse”. Shortlisted alongside the Edinburgh Futures Institute is the Paisley Central Library by Collective Architecture and the Tarlair Outdoor Pool Pavilion by Studio Octopi.

Last year’s winner was a public park renewed by studios Stallan-Brand and LDA Design.

Film and photography by Jim Stephenson.

Breaking: Hickey Stages: Understanding and Managing Love Bites Effectively

📅 05 Jul 2024 | ⏱️ 4 min read (775 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Greatist

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that hickeys, or as scientists call them, subdermal hematomas, are love’s graffiti.
  • A hickey, medically known as a subdermal contusion or hematoma, is simply a bruise that forms as a result of vigorous kissing or sucking on soft skin, typically around the neck.
  • From a medical standpoint, hickeys are intriguing.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that hickeys, or as scientists call them, subdermal hematomas, are love’s graffiti. If you’ve ever scrambled for scarves or turtlenecks, welcome to the kissing booth of knowledge! Join us as we navigate the lifecycle of hickeys, from their eye-catching start to their subtle fade, and learn how to speed up their departure.

A hickey, medically known as a subdermal contusion or hematoma, is simply a bruise that forms as a result of vigorous kissing or sucking on soft skin, typically around the neck. This intense suction causes the tiny blood vessels under the skin, a.k.a. capillaries, to burst and release blood into the surrounding tissues. The immediate result? An unmistakable red or purple mark that gradually shifts to a darker shade as it heals.

From a medical standpoint, hickeys are intriguing. They showcase the skin’s sensitivity and the body’s rapid response to minor vascular injury. Not so romantic when you think about it scientifically, right? But hey, it’s all part of the human experience of showing affection — or something like that.

Sources indicate that when you get a hickey, your body starts a healing process that resembles how it deals with other bruises. Here’s a more detailed look at each stage of a hickey’s life cycle.

Immediately after the passionate moment, a hickey appears on the skin, screaming in shades of bright red or deep purple. This initial coloration is due to blood from the ruptured capillaries pooling beneath the skin’s surface in response to the suction. It’s your skin’s way of signaling that there’s been some minor internal damage in that area.

As the hickey begins to heal, it undergoes a whole wardrobe of color transformations, showcasing your body’s metabolic process at work.

Initially, the hickey darkens as the blood begins to oxidize. Then, after a few days, the body starts to break down and reabsorb the blood, so it turns lighter — going from blue to green to brown and, finally, mellow yellow. This rainbow journey reflects the breakdown of hemoglobin, the iron-containing substance in the blood, into biliverdin and bilirubin.

Finally, your hickey starts to ghost you. Over a week or two, depending on factors like your skin type, overall health, how severe the hickey was., and how your body rides the healing waves, the last traces of your hickey fade into nothing.

During this stage, the body’s immune system clears away the remaining by-products of the broken-down blood. White blood cells swoop in like a cleanup crew at a festival, gobbling up and digesting the debris in a process called phagocytosis, while increased blood flow to the area helps to flush out the remnants.

Need a hickey gone yesterday? Here’s how to help your hickey heal. Start with a cold pack — grab a spoon from the freezer or a chilled gel pack and gently press it against your hickey. This will help reduce any swelling and scatter the blood pooling under your skin, which can help minimize that bold bruise.

In a recent development, after using cold treatment for the first 48 hours, it’s time to turn up the heat. Switch to warm compresses to get the blood flowing smoothly again. A few minutes a few times a day invites more circulation to the hickey zone, helping you hustle through healing and clear out the blood remnants more swiftly.

You can also try a dab of comfrey ointment. Research demonstrates it may reduce bruise size and coloration for some peeps.

Caught off guard? A little concealer or foundation over the hickey makes it less noticeable.

Not into makeup? Scarves and high-necked shirts are also great accessories for your camouflage arsenal.

Typically, a hickey will last anywhere from 5 days to 2 weeks, depending on its severity and your body’s healing capabilities.

In a recent development, communication is key! Let your partner know your feelings about receiving a hickey — some might find it fun, while others may prefer to keep their necks clear.

While generally harmless, hickeys can sometimes lead to complications like skin infections or, very rarely, blood clots. It’s best to keep the affection gentle to avoid any complications.

Recent findings suggest that hickeys are nothing more than bruises in disguise. They start as bright red to purple love stamps and gradually fade over several days to a couple of weeks. Speed up the process with heat and cold packs or a splodge of comfrey cream.

Sources indicate that remember, the best approach to handling hickeys — like all aspects of relationships — is communication and care. So go forth, love responsibly, and keep a scarf handy, just in case!

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

According to recent reports, wondering how to get rid of mosquito bites overnight? Discover simple home remedies for quick relief. From crushed ice to aloe vera, explore easy solutions to soothe itching and inflammation for a peaceful night’s sleep.

Industry observers note that if you’re caught without bug bite cream or ointment, don’t worry — plenty of simple home remedies can provide quick relief. From soothing aloe vera to the calming effects of oatmeal, discover easy solutions to alleviate itching and inflammation so you can sleep peacefully.

Just as you’d ice an injury, icing a bug bite can help decrease inflammation and temporarily numb the pain.

If icy cold treatments aren’t your vibe, you can apply heat instead to soothe your bump.

Aloe vera gel does more than soothe sunburns! It can also help ease bug bites and help them heal.

Baking soda can remove the itch. To make a paste, mix 1 tablespoon of it with a splash of water (not too much). Apply it to your bite as you would zit cream. Keep it on for 10 minutes before rinsing it off.

Did you know basil (yes, like the kind in your pasta) has a rich history as a skin infection remedy? It contains antioxidants that may bring down bug bite inflammation.

Industry observers note that to whip up your own basil rub, boil a couple cups of water with 1/2 ounce of dried basil leaves. Cool the mixture before applying it to a washcloth and gently massaging it onto the bite for sweet relief.

You already know apple cider vinegar (fermented liquid from apples) is a huge player in the natural remedy world.

Some people use it to clean due to its antimicrobial effects, and others mix it into food or drinks for its possible health benefits (like helping with blood sugar concerns).

Its beauty with bites is that it can help ease burning or stinging while disinfecting your scratchy little bump.

It has been revealed that onion juice (while not delicious) has antifungal and antibacterial properties, which could possibly help ward off infection. Plus, it could make your bite sting less. Just dab a bit of raw onion juice onto your bites. The downside? We’re not sure how well it works … and it’s kinda stinky.

In a recent development, thyme has been used to help with skin concerns for a long time. You can use it to help decrease irritation by chopping it up and applying the teeny leaves directly to your bite for 10 minutes. You can also boil thyme, soak a cloth in the cooled liquid, and wrap it around your bite.

Recent findings suggest that peppermint oil may work as an anti-itch agent. Mix it with carrier oil (like olive oil) before applying it to your skin, though!

Another natural anti-itcher and astringent, lemon balm, may be helpful. You can either apply a lemon balm cream or chop up the leaves and apply them right to the bite.

In a recent development, witch hazel is a natural wonder with many uses for skin concerns such as acne and psoriasis. It can tackle inflammation and burning while helping your bug bite heal.

This herb may work, but the science is a little dicey. On its own, arnica is toxic, so any over-the-counter products you find have been carefully diluted for your safety.

Sources indicate that the yummy tea that calms and soothes at bedtime has many other uses, including potentially calming an irritated bug bite. Steep the tea bag for 20 minutes before squeezing it out and applying it to your bite once it’s cooled.

In a recent development, blend minced garlic with petroleum jelly or fragrance-free lotion. Place the mixture on your bite for 10 minutes before removing it and applying a cool cloth.

Icing the bite for 10 minutes and then placing a mixture of baking soda and water on it for 10 minutes is a strong choice.

Though not tested for this purpose, some people turn to Vicks to soothe mosquito bites. It’s possible that its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties could help heal and soothe mosquito bites. But FYI, this product isn’t considered the best defense against mosquito bites.

Sources indicate that some toothpastes are cooling, so that sensation may offer temporary relief. Some people use toothpaste on insect bites since many toothpastes contain astringents, which can help shrink tissues.

Recent findings suggest that using repellent to prevent bug bites is a good idea. PSA: DEET and lemon eucalyptus oil are safe ways to repel insects.

It has been revealed that mosquitoes are low-key little monsters that cause the most insect bites worldwide. Most bites aren’t serious, but mosquitoes can potentially carry diseases.

Recent findings suggest that ointments, creams, or simple home remedies can help stop the pesky itch after bites. But remember that some natural substances can cause allergic reactions. That mentioned, it’s always a good idea to do a patch test first.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that the best environmental storytelling in video games doesn’t always hit you in the face and demand you stop to look, and GTA 6 has perfected that.
  • Rockstar’s developers say that kind of discovery is central to Grand Theft Auto 6, a world designed to reward players who take their time.
  • In a recent development, “The life is in the detail of Grand Theft Auto VI,” indicates Adam Cochrane, Vice President of Art: Environment.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that the best environmental storytelling in video games doesn’t always hit you in the face and demand you stop to look, and GTA 6 has perfected that. Sometimes it’s a carefully dressed room, an overgrown garden, or a detail you spot out of the corner of your eye while heading somewhere else.

Rockstar’s developers say that kind of discovery is central to Grand Theft Auto 6, a world designed to reward players who take their time. After three weeks of playing GTA 6, I'd say the world-building is some of the best, most detailed, and most nuanced I've experienced. It can be as small as mud on a character's trainers, a branded coffee mug, or a car decal.

In a recent development, “The life is in the detail of Grand Theft Auto VI,” indicates Adam Cochrane, Vice President of Art: Environment. “The subtle sway of trees or bunting swaying in the wind. A puddle of bin juice around the bottom of a dumpster, or an overgrown garden in a property that is unoccupied.”.

It’s the sort of detail that makes a place feel inhabited rather than assembled for a game. Cochrane points to the personalisation of homes and businesses, and the little vignettes the teams have added for players to discover. Some offer in-game rewards; others are there simply to be found.

“Then you zoom out, and you look at the sheer scale of the world, and you realise that the detail you’ve been discovering on such a small scale is quite literally everywhere across the vast landscape of this world,” he says. “Then you realise that it’s all been curated, considered, and created by a human hand, and you can’t quite believe it.”.

In a recent development, that thinking extends beyond what you can see. Steven Messinger, Senior Design Director: Open World, explains that Rockstar has built deep backstories for things players may only glimpse. The game’s gang compounds, for example, have a fully mapped drug network, from supply routes to street-level buyers.

“Players will only pick up on bits and pieces of this,” Messinger notes, “but having that structure in the background as something we consistently refer to helps everything feel more real, like this significant machine is always running even when players aren’t there.”.

It’s a huge amount of work for details many players may miss. That’s rather the point.
